podcast.title: Source of Rage
podcast.body: Rise Against is highlighted as a band that consistently provides a "good source of rage" through their music, indicating their output is often characterized by intense, angry, and rebellious themes. "Rise against is a good source of rage."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Unexpected Warped Tour Resume Entry
podcast.body: Rise Against is noted as an artist whose appearance on the Warped Tour might be an unexpected addition to their career history. "Here are some other artists that you may not have expected to have warped on their resume... Rise Against..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Zero DB Initiative Signatory
podcast.body: Rise Against is among the artists who signed the Zero DB initiative, formed in 2008 as part of the charity Reprieve. This initiative encourages condemnation of music as torture and advocates for governments to enforce the Convention Against Torture and other treaties related to the treatment of prisoners. "The Sinees include Tom Morello, average against the machine, members of REM, rise against Pearl Jam, Trent Reznor, Limp Biscuit, system of a down, disturbed the estate of Prince, the Chili Peppers, Eminem, Marilyn Manson, Neil Diamond, Dr. Dre, and a host of others."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Influence on Rock Music
xref.body: The Ramones are credited with profoundly influencing countless rock bands over several decades, with a direct lineage tracing back to their original version for bands like Rise Against, Metallica, Blink 182, Motorhead, Green Day, Guns N' Roses, The Clash, Sex Pistols, Rancid, The Pixies, The Beastie Boys, Alice in Chains, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden, The Strokes, The Offspring, and Red Hot Chili Peppers. "virtually any rock band of the last 25 years, 35 years, and you can draw a line back into the past, and that line will inevitably lead back to the Ramones."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
